rules.interpretation: Count footnotes; exclude tables, maps, bibliographies and appendices. Other content and adjustments need an explicit method.
Apply course limits when evidenced; otherwise doctoral 100000 and research masters 50000. Targets of 80000 and 40000 are recommendations.
An excess needs a scoped recorded decision and approval evidence. Byte identity cannot establish authority.
Thesis language governs approval and summary applicability; label locale does not.
English-summary range: doctoral 5000–10000; research masters 2500–5000.
Creative components need descriptions, agreed dissertation/output percentages totaling 100 and electronic components.
Final deposit includes durable copies of integral components, including online content.
Acknowledge all funding and applicable grant identifiers; RTP includes fee offsets.
Disclose other-qualification work and work before enrolment separately.
Disclose human/digital assistance in detail; preserve private digital-use records. Supervisors: C/D/E; other editing: D/E.

rules.clause: GenAI use and academic integrity; Edit your thesis
rules.interpretation: AI is not an author. Authors remain responsible for verification and editorial integrity.
Ethics applications belong outside the thesis and appendices.
Record citation, venue/date where applicable, one of five official statuses, locations, contributions and publication versions.
Assess substantial contribution and contractual rights; use an appropriate permitted version. No fixed universal authorship percentage is specified.

rules.clause: Declaration of incorporated publications; Completing the forms
rules.interpretation: Keep supervisor/coordinating-author declarations separate; combine forms for TES. A figure-only contribution has a stated form exception.

rules.clause: Format of the thesis: reference-list questions
rules.interpretation: Exclude incorporated works from the thesis-wide list; references inside a verbatim publication may include them. Internal reference lists need not be duplicated.
An integrated argument, suitable candidature work and updated literature remain scholarly review decisions.
Upload one written-thesis file; TES filenames must omit commas and hashtags.

rules.clause: Generate an iThenticate report; Submit your thesis
rules.interpretation: Use a full-thesis report for supervisor/chair review. A supplied report does not establish originality.
Matching-source exclusions may cover complete incorporated publications, not merely included material; explain filters.
The submission version must match the supervisor-reviewed version.
Retain final corrections and chair approval decisions; masters amendment treatment differs by submission date and needs review.
Geometry, title order, logo/signature absence and pagination need actual output inspection.
Required section order and abstract range need actual rendered evidence.
